thread:
Cara Nguyen: small UX/copy roundup from today's QA: retention label reads 'Retention' and it's ambiguous; users ask if 0=delete or infinite. also region dropdown shows friendly name only which conflicts with infra (they want region code).
Diego Ramos: agree. propose 'Retention period (days)' with helper '0 = retain indefinitely' (legal ok?) and numeric input next to slider for precision. region tile -> 'US East (us-east-1)' to show both.
Maya Patel: KMS badge copy is weak: currently 'KMS: On'. Test variants: 'Key custody: Redwood' / 'Key custody: Customer (KMS)' and 'Encryption: Customer-managed (KMS)'. prefer the 'Key custody' phrasing for legal alignment.
aria-bot: Accessibility check: badge contrast 3.7:1 fail. Recommend text color #053F9A or semi-bold to reach >=4.5:1. Add aria-label e.g. 'Key custody: Customer (KMS)'.
Cara Nguyen: audit logs need actor + key arn. suggested CSV row: '2026-04-01T14:12:00Z, cara.nguyen@example.com, key_custody, Redwood -> Customer (KMS: arn:aws:kms:...)'. Also label download button ordering.
Diego Ramos: I'll implement numeric input, region tooltip for truncated codes, contextual primary CTA (if adding key show 'Confirm key' as primary), and update badge styles. Will prototype two copy options and ping compliance for sign-off.
Maya Patel: thanks — please ensure keyboard focus order doesn't change when CTA flips. Add checklist to design file.
